KitchenWorkspace.title: KitchenWorkspace
KitchenWorkspace.description: Per-user Hot Kitchen Par Stock workspace configuration storing the active Monday week start date.

ownerId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns this kitchen workspace.

weekStart.description: Selected week start date (Monday) in YYYY-MM-DD format.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

ParStockItem.title: ParStockItem
ParStockItem.description: Single Hot Kitchen Par Stock ingredient row with category, unit, and daily Monday-Sunday counts.

ownerId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns this stock item.

sortOrder.description: Numeric display order of the ingredient item.

category.description: Ingredient category name (e.g., BREAKFAST / GENERAL, MEAT, DRY STORE).

mon.description: Monday stock count or null if blank.

tue.description: Tuesday stock count or null if blank.

wed.description: Wednesday stock count or null if blank.

thu.description: Thursday stock count or null if blank.

fri.description: Friday stock count or null if blank.

sat.description: Saturday stock count or null if blank.

sun.description: Sunday stock count or null if blank.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

/kitchens/{kitchenId}.description: Root kitchen workspace document keyed by the authenticated user's UID.

/kitchens/{kitchenId}/items/{itemId}.description: Subcollection of Hot Kitchen Par Stock items belonging to the workspace.
